# CLI Reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_cli_reference.py --write. Do not edit by hand. -->

`python chatgpt_phone_reg.py` (or `python -m sms_tool`) builds this parser. The
table is generated from it, so a flag that exists is listed and a flag that was
removed disappears. Options hidden from `--help` (internal IPC and test seams)
are omitted.

| Option | Value | Help |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--approve-proxy` | value | Stage 3 proxy for ChatGPT approve (target country exit) |
| `--approve-proxy-country` | choices: `US`, `GB`, `DE`, `JP`, `BR`, `TR`, `TH`, `VN`, `ID`, `IN`, `NL`, `KR`, `PL`, `CH`, `PH` | Rotate approve proxy credentials to this exit country |
| `--approve-proxy-pool` | value | Approve proxy pool; comma or newline separated |
| `--at` | value | Access Token (JWT) for --generate-ba-link/--generate-upi-qr |
| `--auto-pay` | — | Automate PayPal payment (reverse protocol first, browser fallback) |
| `--auto-pay-headless` | — | Run auto-pay browser headless |
| `--auto-pay-reverse-only` | — | Use reverse protocol only, no browser fallback |
| `--auto-pay-timeout` | value | Seconds to wait for auto-pay completion |
| `--auto-proxy-country` | — | Let the payment router probe each proxy and match the backend-required exit country |
| `--ba-token` | value | PayPal BA token for --omakse-us-pay |
| `--batch-auto-pay` | — | Run auto-pay for all pending accounts in SQLite |
| `--batch-auto-pay-limit` | value | Max accounts to process in batch (0=all) |
| `--blik-code` | value | Six-digit BLIK code; supplying it explicitly executes the BLIK payment |
| `--browser-headless` | — | Run Playwright registration headless |
| `--browser-visible` | — | Run Playwright registration with a visible browser |
| `--buy-cfworker-mailbox` | — | Use CF Worker temp mailboxes before registration |
| `--buy-remail-mailbox` | — | Buy ReMail long-term mailbox before registration |
| `--buy-smailr-mailbox` | — | Use Smailr disposable mailboxes before registration |
| `--cfworker-domain` | value | CF Worker mailbox domain, default cfworker_domain in config.json |
| `--change-email` | — | Batch change ChatGPT protocol email addresses |
| `--change-email-mailbox-file` | value | Credential pool for persistent target email providers |
| `--chatai-mailbox-file` | value | Legacy mixed mailbox file: Chatai plus all unified mailbox formats |
| `--check-payment-eligibility` | — | Explicitly enumerate payment methods via disposable Checkout and Stripe init; can trigger risk controls |
| `--check-promotion` | — | Probe accounts/check plan and Plus-trial/discount (优惠) eligibility and persist promotion_status |
| `--check-promotion-after-registration` | — | After registration, probe saved successful accounts for Plus trial/discount eligibility |
| `--checkout-country`, `--billing-country` | value | Hosted/UPI checkout billing country/currency, e.g. US or JP |
| `--checkout-proxy` | value | Stage 1 proxy for checkout (JP/TH exit) |
| `--checkout-proxy-country` | choices: `US`, `GB`, `DE`, `JP`, `BR`, `TR`, `TH`, `VN`, `ID`, `IN`, `NL`, `KR`, `PL`, `CH`, `PH` | Rotate checkout proxy credentials to this exit country |
| `--checkout-proxy-pool` | value | Checkout proxy pool; comma or newline separated |
| `--codex-export-dir` | value | Directory for Codex JSON exports |
| `--confirm-proxy` | value | Explicit Stripe confirm proxy |
| `--convert-format` | choices: `cpa`, `sub2api`, `cockpit`, `9router`, `codex`, `axonhub`, `codexmanager` | Output format for --convert-session-json |
| `--convert-output` | value | Optional output path for --convert-session-json |
| `--convert-session-json` | value | Convert ChatGPT/Codex session JSON file to another import format |
| `--cpa-api-token` | value | CPA API token, defaults to cpa/cpa_mode.api_token in config.json |
| `--cpa-api-url` | value | CPA API base URL, defaults to cpa/cpa_mode.api_url in config.json |
| `--cpa-domain-filter` | value | Only process CPA accounts under this email domain |
| `--delete-account` | — | Delete/archive one or more accounts through the lifecycle adapter |
| `--doctor` | — | Offline environment self-check (python/node/playwright/curl_cffi/config), then exit |
| `--email` | value | Mailbox email address |
| `--email-access-token` | value | Mailbox access token |
| `--email-file` | value | One email per line for batch operations |
| `--email-password` | value | Mailbox password |
| `--email-refresh-token` | value | Mailbox refresh token |
| `--export-codex-json` | — | Export paid account session as Codex JSON |
| `--extract-payment-link` | — | Extract a protocol payment link through the unified manager |
| `--generate-ba-link` | — | Generate PayPal BA link directly from Access Token |
| `--generate-upi-qr` | — | Generate India UPI hosted payment link and QR directly from Access Token |
| `--gmail-send` | — | Send mail through a configured/selected Gmail mailbox |
| `--gmail-send-body` | value | Plain-text body for --gmail-send |
| `--gmail-send-html` | value | Optional HTML body for --gmail-send |
| `--gmail-send-self` | — | Send --gmail-send to the Gmail mailbox itself |
| `--gmail-send-subject` | value | Subject for --gmail-send |
| `--gmail-send-to` | value | Recipient list for --gmail-send, separated by comma/newline |
| `--import-cpa` | — | Import an existing AT-only session JSON into CPA/SUB2API |
| `--import-target` | choices: `cpa`, `sub2api`, `cliproxyapi` | Target for --import-cpa and 401 re-import |
| `--inbox-limit` | value | Max messages for --view-inbox |
| `--json` | — | Machine-readable JSON output for --doctor |
| `--list-payment-methods` | — | List protocol payment methods and adapter availability |
| `--list-paypal-ba-queue` | — | List durable PayPal BA authorization queue |
| `--list-paypal-links` | — | List saved PayPal payment links |
| `--mailbox-file` | value | Unified mailbox file: Graph, Gmail, ReMail, CFWorker, or iCloud receive URL |
| `--mailbox-pool-repaired` | — | Acknowledge repaired mailbox credentials and reopen automatic 401 relogin |
| `--max-mailbox-purchases` | value | Hard mailbox purchase cap for --target-at200 (default: target x 2) |
| `--max-remail-cost` | value | Optional total ReMail purchase-cost cap for --target-at200 |
| `--max-reuse-count` | value | Max times a phone can be reused (0=config default or 1) |
| `--no-2fa` | — | Skip TOTP 2FA enrollment after a successful registration |
| `--no-jit-at-refresh` | — | Probe the saved AT but do not run email OTP OAuth on HTTP 401 |
| `--no-payment-eligibility` | — | Legacy opt-out of --payment-eligibility; promotion-only is now the default. The Checkout probe creates a disposable session and may trigger risk controls. |
| `--no-phone-reuse` | — | Disable phone verification even when smsbower is configured |
| `--no-require-zero` | — | Allow non-zero amount (default: require 0) |
| `--no-scan-workspace-status` | — | Deprecated compatibility flag; --one-click-scan no longer performs workspace checks |
| `--no-session-refresh` | — | Do not refresh session before Codex JSON export |
| `--omakse-base-url` | value | Omakse server base URL (default: http://oai.omakse.xyz) |
| `--omakse-client-id` | value | Client ID for US protocol payment (auto-generated if omitted) |
| `--omakse-concurrency` | value | Concurrency for link extraction |
| `--omakse-extract` | — | Extract PayPal links via omakse server (POST /api/link-extract/jobs) |
| `--omakse-load-return-url` | — | Load return URL in US payment flow |
| `--omakse-local-proxy` | value | Local proxy to reach the omakse server |
| `--omakse-max-attempts` | value | Max attempts per credential for link extraction |
| `--omakse-max-poll-seconds` | value | Max seconds to poll for job completion |
| `--omakse-phone-cc` | value | Phone country code for US protocol payment |

| `--omakse-poll-interval` | value | Seconds between status polls |
| `--omakse-preconfirm-phone` | — | Pre-confirm phone in US payment flow |
| `--omakse-promo-country` | value | Promotion region country for link extraction |
| `--omakse-promo-proxies` | value | Promotion-region proxy list for link extraction (newline-separated) |
| `--omakse-provider-country` | value | PayPal provider country for link extraction |
| `--omakse-proxy-region` | value | Proxy region for US protocol payment |
| `--omakse-randomize-device` | — | Randomize device fingerprint for US payment |
| `--omakse-send-otp` | — | Send phone OTP in US payment flow |
| `--omakse-us-pay` | — | Run US PayPal protocol payment via omakse server |
| `--omakse-us-proxies` | value | US proxy list for link extraction (newline-separated) |

| `--open-paypal-link` | — | Open saved PayPal payment link for --email |
| `--paid-timeout` | value | Seconds to wait for UPI payment when --wait-paid is set (default 900) |
| `--password` | value | Use a specific password |
| `--payment-batch-id` | value | Batch ID; reused only together with --payment-resume-checkpoint |
| `--payment-canary` | value | Limit a payment batch to the first N unique accounts |
| `--payment-country` | value | UPI local payment-method country, e.g. IN |

| `--payment-method`, `--payment-link-method` | choices: `paypal`, `gopay`, `go_pay`, `go-pay`, `gcash`, `grabpay`, `grab_pay`, `grab-pay`, `upi`, `upiqr`, `upi_qr`, `upi-qr`, `ideal`, `pix`, `kakao`, `kakao_pay`, `kakao-pay`, `blik`, `twint`, `direct_card`, `direct-card`, `directcard`, `direct`, `zhika`, `card`, `checkout`, `momo`, `momo_qr`, `momo-qr`, `momoqr`, `qris`, `qris_id`, `bizum`, `bizum_es`, `naver_pay`, `naverpay`, `naver-pay` | Protocol payment-link method |

| `--payment-resume-checkpoint` | — | Explicitly resume matching accounts from an existing payment batch checkpoint |
